import json
d=json.load(open('.ai/task/repair-w47a-20260927/CONTEXTUAL-ENVELOPE-f9a2.json'))
p=d['payload']
out=[]
for i,(t,b) in enumerate(zip(p['translation_snapshot'],p['bounded_context'])):
  c=json.loads(b['context'])
  out.append(f'=== [{i}] {c.get(\"section\")} tag={c.get(\"source_tag\")} comp={c[\"source_evidence\"].get(\"component\") if c.get(\"source_evidence\") else None}')
  out.append('SRC: '+t['source'])
  out.append('TGT: '+t['target'])
  for a in c.get('adjacent_translations',[]): out.append('  ADJ: '+a['source'][:150].replace(chr(10),' ')+' => '+a['target'][:150].replace(chr(10),' '))
  extra=[k for k in c if k not in ('adjacent_translations','file','line','section','source_evidence','source_tag')]
  if extra: out.append('  EXTRA: '+json.dumps({k:c[k] for k in extra},ensure_ascii=False)[:1500])
  se=c.get('source_evidence') or {}
  sk=[k for k in se if k not in ('component','excerpts')]
  if sk: out.append('  SE: '+json.dumps({k:se[k] for k in sk},ensure_ascii=False)[:1500])
open('/tmp/f9a2.txt','w').write(chr(10).join(out))
"; wc -l /tmp/f9a2.txt

cd /workspace/tome4-chinese-translation; python3 -c "
import json
d=json.load(open('.ai/task/repair-w47a-20260927/CONTEXTUAL-ENVELOPE-f9a2.json'))
keys=d['payload']['ordered_revision_keys']
iss={25:'源文 PENDOR 说枪手们 \"Scared scrapless\"（吓得魂飞魄散的双关），并无贬损之意；译文「那群废物们吓得不轻」凭空加入「废物」的辱骂，改变了说话人对部下的态度（tome-orcs/data/lore/palace-fumes.lua 快照 b57c1122…，来源未固定）。',
30:'Shasshhiy\'Kaish 在正文中译为「莎西·凯希」（带间隔号），而同文件相邻条目 \"demon statue: Shasshhiy\'Kaish\" 译为「恶魔雕像：莎西凯希」，同一专名跨条写法不一致；冻结术语快照无此名条目可作依据，需统一。',
73:'源文 \"usually a blighted daelach has to be immediately put down\" 含限定词 usually；译文「而且，一个枯萎化的达莱奇必须立刻被处死」删去「通常」，把惯常做法说成必然，且与下文「有一个样本……维持了平衡与可控性」的例外相矛盾（tome-ashes-urhrok/data/lore/demon.lua:492，快照 d3adada5…，来源未固定）。'}
v=[]
for i,k in enumerate(keys):
  v.append({'revision_key':k,'verdict':'ISSUE','observation':iss[i]} if i in iss else {'revision_key':k,'verdict':'OK'})
print(json.dumps({'contract':'translation_contextual_v2','candidate_identity':d['candidate_identity'],'verdicts':v},ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')))
" > /tmp/f9a2-out.json; cat /tmp/f9a2-out.json
